svg.aria-label: From a change to a release. make check runs gofmt, go vet and staticcheck for Linux and Windows, shellcheck, the unit tests with the race detector, and the layers and changelog tests. make test-windows runs every package again as a Windows program, from WSL. CI runs both, fuzzing and govulncheck, builds the release zips and the demo image, tests on Windows x64 and ARM64, shrinks a throwaway distribution on a real WSL 2, and runs install.ps1 in PowerShell 5.1 and 7, on every push and pull request and once a week. A vX.Y.Z tag runs all of CI, then publishes the zips with checksums, build provenance and a Scoop manifest, and the demo image; then it installs the release to check it.
